_meta.note: Canonical product catalog for Dew Theory. Wholesale/retail figures are from the client's product line document. Ingredient, usage, and skin-type data were researched against Skin Script's own product pages and multiple authorized Skin Script retailers, then paraphrased — they are NOT invented, but should still be read and confirmed by Emily before publishing, since formulas are occasionally revised by the manufacturer. See OPEN_ITEMS.md for the two unresolved items (SPF retail price, lip treatment SKU structure).
_meta.pricing_rule: retail_price = wholesale_price x 2, applied uniformly. Confirmed against 7 of 8 client-supplied pairs; the 8th (SPF) had no retail figure in the source document and was computed with the same formula — flagged for confirmation, not treated as given fact.

shipping_rule.applies_to: order subtotal before discount codes (recommended default — see OPEN_ITEMS.md)

_meta.sources_researched: skinscriptrx.com (manufacturer) and authorized retailers including artofskincare.com, skincarebyalana.com, naturalbeautyspa.com, incidecoder.com. All product marketing copy below is paraphrased, not copied.

products.name: Green Tea Citrus Cleanser

key_actives.name: Green Tea (Camellia Sinensis) Leaf Extract + EGCG
key_actives.function: Antioxidant; helps limit acne-causing bacteria while protecting the skin's healthy microbiome.

key_actives.name: Grape Seed Extract
key_actives.function: Polyphenol-rich antioxidant; supports skin balance and calms redness.

key_actives.name: Grapefruit & Lemon Peel Oil
key_actives.function: Vitamin C source; clarifies and brightens, contributes the citrus scent.

key_actives.name: Wild Cherry Bark Extract
key_actives.function: Soothing, anti-inflammatory.

products.how_to_use: Apply to damp skin, massage in circular motions for about 60 seconds to emulsify and lift impurities, then rinse with warm water.
products.description_short: A foaming gel cleanser built around green tea and citrus extracts — clarifies oily and combination skin without over-stripping it.

products.name: Mandelic Brightening Serum
products.category_note: Named 'serum' by the manufacturer, but functions as a leave-on chemical exfoliant — categorized as Exfoliant per client instruction.

key_actives.name: L-Mandelic Acid (5%)
key_actives.function: Larger-molecule AHA; exfoliates, brightens, improves texture with a lower irritation profile than glycolic acid.

key_actives.name: Azeloglicina® / Potassium Azelaoyl Diglycinate (3%)
key_actives.function: Tyrosinase inhibitor; fades dark spots, calms redness, regulates oil.

key_actives.name: Niacinamide
key_actives.function: Barrier support, tone-evening, calming.

key_actives.name: BioFense™ (Lactobacillus Ferment)
key_actives.function: Probiotic microbiome support, reduces acne-related redness.

key_actives.name: Synovea® HR (Hexylresorcinol)
key_actives.function: Brightener; works with niacinamide for cellular support.

products.how_to_use: After cleansing and toning, apply 3–5 drops to face, neck, and chest once daily (AM or PM). Layer with moisturizer. Apply SPF in the morning when using this product. Start with a lower frequency and build up if no dryness or sensitivity occurs.
products.description_short: A mandelic-acid leave-on exfoliant that brightens and refines texture while regulating oil — gentler than glycolic-based options.

products.name: Botanical Bloom Hydrating Mask
skin_types: all — especially dry, sensitive, or dull

key_actives.name: Super Floral Complex (rose, orchid stem cells, daisy extract)
key_actives.function: Brightens, calms, and helps fade dark spots.

key_actives.name: Triple HA Complex (three molecular weights of hyaluronic acid)
key_actives.function: Multi-depth hydration and plumping.

key_actives.name: Luminescine®
key_actives.function: Absorbs UV energy and re-emits it as visible light, giving an immediate luminous effect.

products.how_to_use: Apply a generous layer after cleansing, avoiding the eye area. Leave on 10–15 minutes and rinse with lukewarm water, or apply thinly as an overnight treatment. Use 1–3 times per week.
products.description_short: A hyaluronic-acid-rich hydrating mask built around a rose, orchid, and daisy botanical complex.

products.name: Ageless Moisturizer

key_actives.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
key_actives.function: Hydrates, soothes, calms irritation.

key_actives.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
key_actives.function: Humectant; binds moisture and builds a hydration reservoir in the skin.

key_actives.name: Ubiquinone (CoQ10)
key_actives.function: Antioxidant; reduces lipid peroxidation and visible wrinkle depth.

key_actives.name: AD-RESYL® (Ophiopogon Japonicus Root Extract)
key_actives.function: Barrier support and redness reduction.

products.how_to_use: After cleansing and toning, apply a thin layer to face, neck, and chest morning and evening.
products.description_short: A lightweight, fast-absorbing daily moisturizer with a satin, matte-leaning finish.

products.name: Hydrating Skin Serum
products.manufacturer_name_note: Sold by Skin Script as 'Ageless Skin Hydrating Serum' — matched via a second retailer's product-page URL. Confirm this is the intended item, not the similarly named Ageless Moisturizer.

key_actives.name: Hyaluronic Acid + Sodium Hyaluronate
key_actives.function: Multi-depth hydration, plumping.

key_actives.name: Phospholipids + Sphingolipids
key_actives.function: Restore the skin's lipid barrier.

key_actives.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38 (Matrixyl Synthe'6)
key_actives.function: Signals collagen and hyaluronic acid production; smooths fine lines.

key_actives.name: Cassia Alata Leaf Extract (DN-AGE)
key_actives.function: Protects against UV-related DNA damage; supports cellular repair.

products.how_to_use: After cleansing and toning, apply 1–2 pumps to the face morning and evening, then follow with moisturizer. Pairs well with retinol or exfoliating acids — apply after those actives have absorbed.
products.description_short: A barrier-focused hydrating serum combining hyaluronic acid with skin-identical lipids and a peptide complex.

products.name: Peppermint & Pomegranate Lip Treatment
products.manufacturer_name_note: Skin Script sells this as 'Ageless Lip Treatment' in two separate scent SKUs, Peppermint and Pomegranate, at the same price. Modeled here as one product with a required scent variant — confirm against OPEN_ITEMS.md whether two SKUs are preferred instead.

key_actives.name: Maxi-Lip™ (Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1)
key_actives.function: Biomimetic peptide; stimulates collagen synthesis for firmness.

key_actives.name: HydraSynol®
key_actives.function: Deep, long-lasting hydration.

key_actives.name: Dermaxyl™ (ceramide + peptide complex)
key_actives.function: Repairs and strengthens the lip barrier.

key_actives.name: Synoxyl® AZ (Acetyl Zingerone)
key_actives.function: Antioxidant; firming.

products.how_to_use: Glide a small amount onto lips. Reapply as needed.
products.description_short: A peptide lip treatment that plumps and hydrates rather than just coating — available in Peppermint or Pomegranate.

products.name: Sheer Protection SPF 30
products.retail_price_note: No retail figure was given in the source document for this item — every other product listed a retail price. Computed here at 2x wholesale to match the confirmed pattern. Confirm before publishing.
skin_types: all — best for normal, dry, combination, sensitive; less ideal for acne-prone due to nut oils

key_actives.name: Zinc Oxide (13.5%)
key_actives.function: Mineral, broad-spectrum UVA/UVB filter; sits on the skin's surface rather than being absorbed.

key_actives.name: Kukui Nut Oil & Macadamia Oil
key_actives.function: Fatty acids; nourishing, easily absorbed.

key_actives.name: Bisabolol, Sandalwood Extract, Phellodendron Amurense Bark Extract
key_actives.function: Calming, anti-inflammatory.

products.how_to_use: Apply in the morning after moisturizer, at least 30 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours. Not waterproof or sweatproof.
products.description_short: A mineral, zinc-oxide sunscreen formulated to sit sheer rather than leave a white cast.
products.source_conflict_note: One lower-authority source described a chemical-filter (octinoxate/octocrylene) version of this product. The large majority of sources — including the manufacturer's own product page — describe a 13.5% zinc-oxide-only mineral formula. This entry follows the majority/manufacturer version; flagged in case Skin Script has multiple SPF 30 SKUs.

products.name: Cucumber Hydration Toner

key_actives.name: Cucumber (Cucumis Sativus) Fruit Extract & Seed Oil
key_actives.function: Cooling, soothing.

key_actives.name: Deuterium Oxide (Heavy Water)
key_actives.function: High molecular weight; reduces trans-epidermal water loss.

key_actives.name: Sodium PCA
key_actives.function: Natural moisturizing factor component; humectant.

key_actives.name: Hyaluronic Acid + Honey + Fructooligosaccharides
key_actives.function: Hydration plus prebiotic microbiome support.

products.how_to_use: After cleansing and exfoliating, spritz onto skin or apply with a cotton round, morning and evening.
products.description_short: A cucumber-based hydrating toner that preps skin to absorb the serums and moisturizer that follow it.
